digest.component_or_area: GitHub Actions CI / pytest job execution
propositions: GitHub Actions pytest matrix jobs on stale Gerrit patchsets 1129/1130/1131/1136 hung for 1.7–4.3 hours at the 99% progress line due to omitted commit 96a0d5c3f (blob prefetch fix) causing unbounded per-blob lazy-fetch RPC cycles (~2.1 hours for 25k files).

The _build-and-test.yml reusable workflow test job had no timeout-minutes configured, allowing GitHub's 360-minute default to retain hung matrix cells indefinitely; adding job-level timeout-minutes: 60 prevents manual-clear dependence while preserving >3x margin on observed normal duration (10–16 min).

Gerrit 1129 PS3 introduced a secondary defect in test_comment_map_matches_the_shared_contract where FakeJiraClient.search_issues ignored startAt/maxResults pagination kwargs, returning the same non-empty page forever and causing the test to exceed the one-minute baseline (timeout at 3s).

The pagination defect was isolated to FakeJiraClient returning unchanged issue lists regardless of pagination parameters; fixing it by slicing results based on startAt/maxResults restored the test to 0.33s and resolved the hang on 1129 PS4.
Downstream patchsets 1130 PS5 rebased on the fixed main completed normally within 16m24s with all four matrix cells terminating without timeout, confirming the hung-run mechanism was eliminated.
